role: One explosion: doExplosionA marches 1352 rays through block resistance into a HashSet of ChunkPosition and damages and pushes nearby entities; doExplosionB draws the sound pitch, destroys and drops the affected blocks in HashSet order and lights fires for a flaming blast.

members.name: explosionRNG
members.note: a det role stream for the fire rolls

members.name: exploder
members.note: left out of the entity pass, the damage source's entity; the block resistance read is func_145772_a's default for every reachable exploder (the wither skull's and the TNT minecart's overrides are off)

members.name: field_77288_k
members.note: the player's knockback, carried by the S27 (sr->s27_x..z, the tick's first S27)

members.name: doExplosionA
members.note: rays, HashSet (jord_set3: a bin of 9 keys takes JDK 8's tree bins, csrc/tests/jorder_trees.txt), entity damage with block_density and blast protection; in the End the blast's entity query reaches the falling and hanging entities (a leash knot's push; serverreplay.c sr_end_blast_query, pfc-endknot-f312)

members.name: doExplosionB
members.note: false on the server (explosion.c); true on the client from the S27, whose side data carries the blast's ore and spawner blocks: their dropBlockAsItemWithChance draws on the client world too (pfc-oreblast-s5)

members.name: func_77277_b
members.note: the map's player entry, read by newExplosion's S27

members.name: getExplosivePlacedBy
members.note: the TNT's placer (expl_placed_by_player) or the living exploder (a creeper): the damage source's entity

notes: explosion.h's header comment lists older gaps (knockback map, non-null exploder) that later code partly closed; I trusted the code over the comment. explosion_rng was not directly confirmed as a symbol name beyond its use at the fire roll. Closed by lane/idxworld: doExplosionB(true) runs on the client from every explosion's S27 (particles_live_explosion_packet: the sound's two draws and five per affected block on WorldClient.rand, which the live client does not carry, and the huge or large explosion; idx-blast-s1 holds the client's explosion particles to the oracle client's at every frame). Entity.func_145772_a and func_145774_a answer the block's own resistance and yes for every exploder but the wither skull and the TNT minecart, both off in world.conf. Since lane/endreturn (2026-09-27): the entity pass leaves the health of every item-pool entity but items and orbs alone (a primed TNT, an arrow and a throwable keep Entity.attackEntityFrom: setBeenAttacked, false), explosion.c attack_from_explosion; end-tnt-s42 row 177.
